mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.0% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between the joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS and SPX 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 indicates supply chain contraction, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures, prompting anticipated Federal Reserve tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction above 1500 signals strong housing market health and consumer confidence, supporting sustained consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction, reducing disposable income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between the joint decline of PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE and SPX 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% within a 3-month period signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.
